spans.s:
a. [दुष्टानि खानि यस्मिन्, दुष्टं खनति खन्-ड्, दुःख्-अच् वा] [[Tv.]]] 
__1 Painful, disagreeable, unpleasant; सिंहानां निनदा दुःखाः श्रोतुं दुःखमतो वनम् [[Rām.]] 
__2 Difficult, uneasy. 
-खम् 
__1 Sorrow, grief, unhappiness, distress, pain, agony; सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय शोभते [[
]]; अर्थानामर्जने दुःखमर्जितानां च रक्षणे । आये दुःखं व्यये दुःखं धिगर्थाः कष्टसंश्रयाः ॥ [[
.]] (दुःखम् and दुःखेन are used as adverbs in the sense of ‘hardly’ ‘with difficulty’ ‘or trouble’ [[Ś. 7. 13]]; अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते [[

]]). 
-Comp. 
-अतीत a. freed from pain. 
-अन्तः final emancipation. 
-आर्त, -अन्वित a. pained, afflicted, distressed. 
-कर a. painful, troublesome, 
-गतम् adversity, calamity; [[

.]] 
-ग्रामः ‘the scene of suffering’, worldly existence. 
-छिन्न a. 
__1 tough, hard. 
__2 pained, distressed. 
-च्छेद्य also दुःखोच्छेद्य a. 
__1 hard. 
__2 to be conquered with difficulty. प्रजानुरागाद्धर्माच्च दुःखोच्छेद्यो हि धार्मिकः [[

.]] 
-जात a. feeling pain. 
-जीविन् a. living in pain or distress; [[

.]] 
-त्रयाभिघातः unbearable association of the three sufferings; दुःखत्रयाभिघाताज्जिज्ञासा [[Sāṅ.

.]] 
-दुःखम् (instr.) with great difficulty; (धारयन्ती) शय्योत्सड्गे निहितमसकृद्दुःखदुःखेन गात्रम् [[

.]] 
-दुःखिन् a. having sorrow upon sorrow; मया रक्षति दुःखदुखी [[

.]] 
-दोह्या (a cow) difficult to be milked. 
-प्राय, बहुल a. full of trouble or grief. 
-भागिन्, -भाज् a. unhappy. [[

.]] भोगः occurrence of trouble or misery. 
-योगः infliction of pain; [[Ms.]] 
-लव्य a. hard to be pierced or cut; [[B.

.]] 
-लोकः worldly life, the world as a scene of constant suffering. 
-शील a. 
__1 hard to please [Page0819-2] or manage, bad tempered, irritable; उपेत्य सा दोहददुःखशीलताम् [[

]]; [[Ś. 4.]] 
__2 accustomed to the misery of; कामेकपत्नीव्रतदुःखशीलाम् [[

]]; ‘who is accustomed to (suffer) the misery (hard lot) of a perfectly chaste life. 
-संचार a. 
__1 passing (time) unhappily. 
__2 impassable 
-सागरः ‘the sea of troubles’; worldly life.
Den. Ā. To feel pain, be distressed. (Also दुःख्यति Den. P.)

a. [दुःख तार° इतच्] 
__1 Distressed, afflicted, pained; दुःखिता यत्र दृश्येरन् विकृताः पापकारिणः [[

a. 
__1 Distressed, afflicted, pained. 
__2 Difficult, painful. 
__3 poor, miserable.
Den. P. To suffer pain, be distressed; दुःखीयति सुखहेतोः को मूढः सेवकादन्यः [[
